#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <cstring>
using namespace std;

const int MAX = 1000007;
int n, T;
char s1[15][15], s2[15][15];
int id[15][15], cnt;
int s, t;
int xz, yz;
int dir[4][2] = { {0,1}, {0,-1}, {1,0}, {-1,0} };

bool inside(int x, int y) {
    return x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < n && y < n && s1[x][y] >= '0' && s1[x][y] <= '9';
}

vector<int> vv(MAX), cap(MAX), nxt(MAX), h(210, -1);
int e = 0;
int pre[210], vis[210];

void add_edge(int u, int v, int c) {
    vv[e] = v; cap[e] = c; nxt[e] = h[u]; h[u] = e++;
    vv[e] = u; cap[e] = 0; nxt[e] = h[v]; h[v] = e++;
}

int max_flow() {
    int flow = 0;
    while (true) {
        memset(pre, -1, sizeof(pre));
        memset(vis, 0, sizeof(vis));
        queue<int> q;
        q.push(s);
        vis[s] = 1;
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front(); q.pop();
            for (int i = h[u]; i != -1; i = nxt[i]) {
                int v = vv[i];
                if (cap[i] > 0 && !vis[v]) {
                    vis[v] = 1;
                    pre[v] = i;
                    if (v == t) goto augment;
                    q.push(v);
                }
            }
        }
        break;
        augment:
        int f = 1e9;
        for (int v = t; v != s; v = vv[pre[v] ^ 1]) {
            f = min(f, cap[pre[v]]);
        }
        for (int v = t; v != s; v = vv[pre[v] ^ 1]) {
            cap[pre[v]] -= f;
            cap[pre[v] ^ 1] += f;
        }
        flow += f;
    }
    return flow;
}

int main() {
    cin >> n >> T;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) cin >> s1[i];
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) cin >> s2[i];

    memset(h.data(), -1, sizeof(h));
    e = 0;
    memset(id, -1, sizeof(id));
    cnt = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            if (s1[i][j] == 'Z') {
                xz = i; yz = j;
            } else if (inside(i, j)) {
                id[i][j] = ++cnt;
            }
        }
    s = 0; t = 2 * cnt + 1;

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
            if (inside(i, j))
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                    int x = i + dir[d][0], y = j + dir[d][1];
                    if (inside(x, y)) {
                        if (s2[x][y] != 0) {
                            add_edge(id[i][j] + cnt, t, s2[x][y] - '0');
                        }
                        if (s1[i][j] == '0') continue;
                        add_edge(s, id[i][j], s1[i][j] - '0');
                        if (s2[x][y] != 0) {
                            add_edge(id[i][j], id[x][y] + cnt, 10);
                        }
                    }
                }
    cout << max_flow() << endl;
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <cstring>
using namespace std;

const int MAXNODES = 210;
const int MAXEDGES = 1000007;

int n, T;
char grid1[15][15], grid2[15][15];
int node_id[15][15], total_nodes;
int source_node, sink_node;
int special_x, special_y;
int directions[4][2] = { {0,1}, {0,-1}, {1,0}, {-1,0} };

bool is_valid(int x, int y) {
    return x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < n && y < n && grid1[x][y] >= '0' && grid1[x][y] <= '9';
}

int edges_v[MAXEDGES], edges_cap[MAXEDGES], edges_next[MAXEDGES], head[MAXNODES], edge_count = 0;
int parent_node[MAXNODES], visited_node[MAXNODES];

void addEdge(int u, int v, int c) {
    edges_v[edge_count] = v; edges_cap[edge_count] = c; edges_next[edge_count] = head[u]; head[u] = edge_count++;
    edges_v[edge_count] = u; edges_cap[edge_count] = 0; edges_next[edge_count] = head[v]; head[v] = edge_count++;
}

int maxFlow() {
    int total_flow = 0;
    while (true) {
        memset(parent_node, -1, sizeof(parent_node));
        memset(visited_node, 0, sizeof(visited_node));
        queue<int> q;
        q.push(source_node);
        visited_node[source_node] = 1;
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front(); q.pop();
            for (int i = head[u]; i != -1; i = edges_next[i]) {
                int v = edges_v[i];
                if (edges_cap[i] > 0 && !visited_node[v]) {
                    visited_node[v] = 1;
                    parent_node[v] = i;
                    if (v == sink_node) goto augment;
                    q.push(v);
                }
            }
        }
        break;
        augment:
        int flow = 1e9;
        for (int v = sink_node; v != source_node; v = edges_v[parent_node[v] ^ 1]) {
            flow = min(flow, edges_cap[parent_node[v]]);
        }
        for (int v = sink_node; v != source_node; v = edges_v[parent_node[v] ^ 1]) {
            edges_cap[parent_node[v]] -= flow;
            edges_cap[parent_node[v] ^ 1] += flow;
        }
        total_flow += flow;
    }
    return total_flow;
}

int main() {
    cin >> n >> T;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) cin >> grid1[i];
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) cin >> grid2[i];

    memset(head, -1, sizeof(head));
    edge_count = 0;
    memset(node_id, -1, sizeof(node_id));
    total_nodes = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            if (grid1[i][j] == 'Z') {
                special_x = i; special_y = j;
            } else if (is_valid(i, j)) {
                node_id[i][j] = ++total_nodes;
            }
        }
    source_node = 0; sink_node = 2 * total_nodes + 1;

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j)
            if (is_valid(i, j))
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                    int x = i + directions[d][0], y = j + directions[d][1];
                    if (is_valid(x, y)) {
                        if (grid2[x][y] != 0) {
                            addEdge(node_id[i][j] + total_nodes, sink_node, grid2[x][y] - '0');
                        }
                        if (grid1[i][j] == '0') continue;
                        addEdge(source_node, node_id[i][j], grid1[i][j] - '0');
                        if (grid2[x][y] != 0) {
                            addEdge(node_id[i][j], node_id[x][y] + total_nodes, 10);
                        }
                    }
                }
    cout << maxFlow() << endl;
    return 0;
}
